note: Broad stance questions approved Oct 28, 2026. Do not reword, reorder or remove principles; answers are stored on users' devices by id.

principles.text: Should the federal government cut spending to reduce the deficit, even if some programs are reduced?
principles.yesLabel: Cut spending to reduce the deficit

principles.text: Should income tax rates stay at current levels for all income groups, including the highest earners?
principles.yesLabel: Keep current tax rates for all incomes
principles.noLabel: Raise taxes on the highest earners

principles.text: Should Congress increase funding for immigration enforcement and border security?
Should undocumented immigrants who were brought to the U.S. as children be able to earn legal status?
principles.yesLabel: Legal status for people brought here as children
principles.noLabel: No legal status for people brought here as children

principles.text: Should the federal government help pay insurance premiums for people who buy their own health coverage?
Should adults who get Medicaid be required to work, study or volunteer if they are able to?
Should it be faster to get federal approval for energy projects such as pipelines, power plants and power lines?
Should the federal government limit greenhouse gas emissions from power plants and vehicles?
Should all gun sales, including private sales between individuals, require a background check?
principles.yesLabel: Background checks on all gun sales
principles.noLabel: No background check required for private sales

principles.text: Should a concealed-carry permit from one state be valid in every state?
principles.yesLabel: Carry permits valid in every state
principles.noLabel: Each state sets its own carry rules

principles.text: Should the President need approval from Congress before keeping U.S. forces in combat?
principles.noLabel: The President decides on continued combat

principles.text: Should the U.S. keep sending military aid to Ukraine?
Should voters have to show a photo ID to vote in federal elections?
Should every eligible voter be able to vote by mail without giving a reason?
principles.yesLabel: Mail voting for any eligible voter
principles.noLabel: Mail voting only with a reason

principles.text: Should members of Congress and their immediate families be barred from trading individual stocks?
principles.yesLabel: Ban stock trading by members of Congress
principles.noLabel: Allow stock trading by members of Congress

principles.text: Should there be term limits for members of Congress?
Should the federal minimum wage be raised above $7.25 an hour?
principles.noLabel: Keep the federal minimum wage at $7.25

principles.text: Should the U.S. put tariffs on imports to protect American industries, even if some prices go up?
Should social media companies have to verify users' ages and limit accounts for children?
Should federal agencies need a warrant to search Americans' messages collected by foreign intelligence programs?
principles.noLabel: No warrant requirement for those searches

principles.text: Should the federal government cancel some student loan debt?
Should abortion laws be decided by each state rather than set nationwide?
